title: Programme Schedule of Commission Values, Centre Stone Weights and Metals
content:
# Programme Schedule of Commission Values, Centre Stone Weights and Metals

Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions are taken under six programmes, and each programme is offered for a range of quoted totals, builds around a range of centre stone weights and is made in the metals listed for it. The figures below are the programme parameters: the smallest and the largest quoted total a commission may be taken at under the programme, in USD; the smallest and the largest centre stone weight the programme will build around, in carats; and the metals a piece may be made in under the programme.

## Schedule

| Programme | Smallest quoted total | Largest quoted total | Smallest centre stone (carats) | Largest centre stone (carats) | Metals offered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | USD 1499.00 | USD 7999.00 | 0.25 | 2.00 | 14-karat yellow gold, 14-karat white gold |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | USD 2999.00 | USD 19999.00 | 0.30 | 4.00 | 14-karat yellow gold, 14-karat white gold, 18-karat yellow gold, 18-karat white gold |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | USD 5999.00 | USD 49999.00 | 0.50 | 8.00 | 14-karat yellow gold, 14-karat white gold, 18-karat yellow gold, 18-karat white gold, 18-karat rose gold, platinum 950 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | USD 14999.00 | USD 149999.00 | 1.00 | 15.00 | 18-karat yellow gold, 18-karat white gold, 18-karat rose gold, platinum 950 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | USD 7999.00 | USD 89999.00 | 0.25 | 10.00 | 14-karat yellow gold, 18-karat yellow gold, 18-karat white gold, 18-karat rose gold, platinum 950 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | USD 39999.00 | USD 999999.00 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 18-karat yellow gold, 18-karat white gold, 18-karat rose gold, platinum 950, palladium 500 |

## Reading the schedule

- The quoted total range is inclusive at both ends: a quoted total equal to the smallest value listed is within the programme, and one equal to the largest value listed is within it.
- The centre stone range is likewise inclusive at both ends, and it is read in carats to two decimal places.
- A metal not listed against a programme is not offered under that programme.

## Hypothetical readings

- A commission quoted at USD 7999.00 sits at the top of the Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting range and within the Design Studio Custom Setting range, which runs from USD 2999.00 to USD 19999.00.
- A centre stone of 0.30 carats is the smallest the Design Studio Custom Setting builds around; a stone of 0.29 carats falls below it.
- A piece in platinum 950 is offered under Belrose Bespoke Design, the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission, the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission and the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission, and not under either Design Studio programme.
